name: Illinois DNR Natural Areas Stewardship Grant
summary: Grants for conservation land trusts to steward Illinois nature preserves and reserves, covering stewardship work, contractors, equipment and staff time, with a small match. The current application deadline is listed as TBD.

status.quote: Application Deadline: TBD Grant Amount: Up to $100,000 Match: 5% or $1000, whichever is less.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible Applicants: Conservation Land Trusts exempt from taxation under Section 501(c)(3) of the federal Internal Revenue Code

geography.quote: Increase stewardship on dedicated Illinois Nature Preserves and registered Land and Water Reserves

access.quote: Please submit application materials through the Amplifund portal.
